petitions.title: Publish the drain works behind ₹75 crore, and fix Sakinaka Junction
petitions.demand: K/East recorded ₹75 crore spent on storm water drains in 2021-22 to 2023-24, 519% of what was allotted. Sakinaka Junction still floods within 30 minutes of rain. We ask the Assistant Municipal Commissioner to publish the list of drain works, their contractors and completion dates, and to fix the junction before the next monsoon.

petitions.title: Marol Maroshi Road: who resurfaced it, and why is it gone in four months
petitions.demand: K/East recorded ₹108 crore spent on roads over three years, 190% of the allotment. Marol Maroshi Road has been resurfaced three times in two years and has potholes again. We ask for the contractor name, the defect liability period, and the penalty invoked.

petitions.title: Bring back the Marol Naka community bin or collect daily
petitions.demand: Since the bin was removed in May, garbage piles on the corner and is burnt on Sundays. Either restore the bin or make door-to-door collection daily as promised.

Residents on this page report work they cannot find on the ground. We ask the Assistant Municipal Commissioner to publish the list of works, their contractors and completion dates, and to inspect the locations flagged here.
